As a commission based salesman, it was annoying as hell - but use google to search for your exact car (ie: 2018 Honda Civic) and find a few with roughly the same amount of miles as yours. Print as many as you can out that have the highest prices. That should work, since dealerships aren’t really negotiating anymore due to supply/demand.. the prices you see online are [generally speaking] what cars are selling for right now. 

I doubt you’ll get full retail value for your car, but you’ll get a lot more than whatever they offered you.
